name: account.avatar_set
description: Sets the caller's own profile picture to an address account.avatar_upload answered them, or removes it with null. Keeps only the address's path on the core (/files/<signature>/<key>), never a host: the client puts the core's own address in front. A person only, not an agent.
sql: update brandbase.users u set avatar = substring(:src::text from '/files/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}/brandbase/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(?:jpg|png|webp)$') where u.id = brandbase.caller() returning jsonb_build_object('avatar', u.avatar) as result
